4530.title: Native ACP question updates do not create an interactive request
4530.rootCauseOneLine: The OpenCode ACP dialect has no native-question client handler, and native tool-call updates produce timeline items rather than interactive runtime requests.
4530.proposedFix: Capture the real provider question extension and capability negotiation first, then implement an explicit version-compatible question adapter with reply and cancellation tests.
4530.caveats: Both clean-checkout runs exercise the real bb ACP bridge with a scripted ACP peer, not OpenCode. The desktop UI, real OpenCode extension payload, and dismissal error remain unverified. No safe simple-fix PR: the end-to-end provider bug was only partially reproduced.
